name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audit any website for the problems that stop AI assistants finding, trusting and citing it, and that stop AI-referred visitors engaging once they arrive. Emits one report: findings with evidence and severity, prioritized fixes, proactive recommendations, and a plan for measuring whether the fixes worked.

skills.summary: Receives the audit request, runs the other three skills in funnel order, applies the 38-rule catalog and the evidence gate, derives severity, and emits the single audit report.
Funnel stages 2-4 (accessible, renderable, extractable). Per-crawler robots.txt and edge-block detection, sitemap and llms.txt, JavaScript render gap, facts locked in non-text.
Funnel stages 5-6 (extractable, corroborated). Structured data validity and completeness, entity identity and disambiguation, date signals and their contradictions, on-site corroboration.
Funnel stage 8 (retained). Answer-continuity: deep-linkability, hop distance to the promised fact, landing-page orientation, first-paint blockers, self-rescue affordances.
